title: Motivation and Emotion Regulation
description: A biological, cognitive and cultural exploration of human motivation and emotional regulation in the context of lifelong learning and achievement. Explores current research and leading theories of motivation in education and skill development contexts and pays special attention to emotions and motivational patterns that interfere with growth and learning.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of ED-D 572, ED-D 591A (if taken in the same topic).
